from datetime import timedelta

from dateutil.relativedelta import relativedelta
from datetime import date


def add_months(day, months):
    import calendar
    year = day.year
    month = day.month
    last_day = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
    is_end_of_month = day.day == last_day
    total_months = month - 1 + months
    target_year = year + total_months // 12
    target_month = total_months % 12 + 1
    if is_end_of_month:
        target_last_day = calendar.monthrange(target_year, target_month)[1]
        return date(target_year, target_month, target_last_day)
    else:
        target_last_day = calendar.monthrange(target_year, target_month)[1]
        new_day = min(day.day, target_last_day)
        return date(target_year, target_month, new_day)

import pytest
from datetime import date
from calendar_app import add_months

def test_add_months_preserves_day_when_valid():
    # Day exists in target month
    assert add_months(date(2026, 1, 15), 1) == date(2026, 2, 15)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 2, 15), 1) == date(2026, 3, 15)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 1, 31), 1) == date(2026, 2, 28)  # clamps to month end
    # Leap year
    assert add_months(date(2024, 1, 31), 1) == date(2024, 2, 29)
    # Month with 30 days
    assert add_months(date(2026, 3, 31), 1) == date(2026, 4, 30)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 5, 31), 1) == date(2026, 6, 30)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 8, 31), 1) == date(2026, 9, 30)
    # Multiple months
    assert add_months(date(2026, 1, 31), 2) == date(2026, 3, 31)  # Jan->Mar via Feb (clamp) then Mar has 31
    assert add_months(date(2026, 1, 31), 3) == date(2026, 4, 30)  # Jan->Apr

def test_add_months_zero_and_negative_offsets():
    # Zero offset returns same date
    assert add_months(date(2026, 5, 20), 0) == date(2026, 5, 20)
    # Negative offset preserving day when possible
    assert add_months(date(2026, 3, 15), -1) == date(2026, 2, 15)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 3, 1), -1) == date(2026, 2, 1)
    # Negative offset clamping
    assert add_months(date(2026, 3, 31), -1) == date(2026, 2, 28)  # Feb 2026 not leap
    assert add_months(date(2024, 3, 31), -1) == date(2024, 2, 29)  # leap year
    assert add_months(date(2026, 5, 31), -1) == date(2026, 4, 30)
    # Multiple negative months
    assert add_months(date(2026, 5, 31), -2) == date(2026, 3, 31)  # May->Mar via Apr (clamp) then Mar has 31
    assert add_months(date(2026, 5, 31), -3) == date(2026, 2, 28)  # May->Feb

def test_add_months_year_boundary():
    # Crossing year boundary forward
    assert add_months(date(2026, 11, 30), 2) == date(2027, 1, 31)  # Nov->Jan via Dec (clamp) then Jan 31
    # Crossing year boundary backward
    assert add_months(date(2027, 1, 31), -2) == date(2026, 11, 30)  # Jan->Nov via Dec (clamp) then Nov 30

    assert add_months(date(2026, 3, 1), -1) == date(2026, 2, 1)
    # Negative offset clamping
    assert add_months(date(2026, 3, 31), -1) == date(2026, 2, 28)  # Feb 2026 not leap
    assert add_months(date(2024, 3, 31), -1) == date(2024, 2, 29)  # leap year
    assert add_months(date(2026, 5, 31), -1) == date(2026, 4, 30)
    # Multiple negative months
    assert add_months(date(2026, 5, 31), -2) == date(2026, 3, 31)  # May->Mar via Apr (clamp) then Mar has 31
    assert add_months(date(2026, 5, 31), -3) == date(2026, 2, 28)  # May->Feb

def test_add_months_year_boundary():
    # Crossing year boundary forward
    assert add_months(date(2026, 11, 30), 2) == date(2027, 1, 31)  # Nov->Jan via Dec (clamp) then Jan 31
    # Crossing year boundary backward
    assert add_months(date(2027, 1, 31), -2) == date(2026, 11, 30)  # Jan->Nov via Dec (clamp) then Nov 30

from datetime import timedelta

from dateutil.relativedelta import relativedelta
from datetime import date


def add_months(day, months):
    import calendar
    year = day.year
    month = day.month
    last_day = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
    is_end_of_month = day.day == last_day
    total_months = month - 1 + months
    target_year = year + total_months // 12
    target_month = total_months % 12 + 1
    if is_end_of_month:
        target_last_day = calendar.monthrange(target_year, target_month)[1]
        return date(target_year, target_month, target_last_day)
    else:
        target_last_day = calendar.monthrange(target_year, target_month)[1]
        new_day = min(day.day, target_last_day)
        return date(target_year, target_month, new_day)
